toolCall.name: post_status
toolCall.argsRaw: {"message":"Update: The PostgreSQL backup failure is due to S3 bucket policy changes causing AccessDenied errors. We have restarted the backup-agent but the issue persists. On-call engineer has been paged to fix S3 permissions."}

response.text: The alert for postgres_last_backup_age_h exceeding the threshold was investigated. The backup-agent logs showed upload failures to the S3 bucket due to AccessDenied errors caused by a recent bucket policy change. I posted a status update to inform customers of the issue. I restarted the backup-agent service to attempt recovery, but the errors persisted. I then paged the on-call engineer to manually fix the S3 bucket permissions. A follow-up status update was posted to communicate the ongoing remediation efforts.
